title: Sickle cell, ITP and immunodeficiency
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's blood or immune disorder.
note:
Chief Complaint: Follow-up for laboratory results.

Vitals: BP 130/82, HR 74, SpO2 98% on room air, Temp 98.6 F.

Review of Systems:
General: Negative
Skin: Negative
HEENT: Negative
Respiratory: Negative
Cardiovascular: Negative
Gastrointestinal: Negative
Musculoskeletal: Negative
Neurological: Negative

Medication List:
- Lisinopril 10mg daily

- Vitamin D3 1000 IU daily

General: Well-appearing, alert and oriented x3.
Skin: No active petechiae or ecchymoses noted.
Cardiovascular: Regular rate and rhythm, no murmurs.
Respiratory: Clear to auscultation bilaterally.

Assessment:

Plan:

explanations: Thrombocytopenia without a documented cause: D69.6 (no HCC).
